title: Introduction and overview — Su-27
description: Introduction and overview of the Su-27: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The Su-27 is a twin-engine air-superiority fighter built by Sukhoi, entering service in 1985. Its huge range, heavy missile load, and the famous Pugachev's Cobra maneuver made it an icon. About 680 Su-27s were built, plus large families of derivatives — Su-30, Su-33, Su-34, Su-35 — flown worldwide. Baseline facts: Twin-engine air-superiority fighter; service from 1985; ~680 built by Sukhoi; Cobra maneuver fame..
